title: Intersectional inequalities in cancer screening participation in Spain (2009–2025): interactive supplementary figures (cross-classified MAIHDA)
description: Interactive supplementary figures S1, S2 and S3 for the article 'Intersectional inequalities in cancer screening participation in Spain over seven survey waves (2009–2025): a cross-classified MAIHDA analysis' (J Epidemiol Community Health, submitted). Self-contained HTML files (Plotly) showing stratum-level deviations in predicted screening uptake from the average stratum, on the probability scale, for colorectal, breast and cervical cancer screening across seven Spanish national health surveys (EESE 2009, ENSE 2011, EESE 2014, ENSE 2017, EESE 2020, ESdE 2023, ESdE 2025). Also includes the R code used to generate the figures.
